rationale: The description meaningfully specifies conventional privacy-management functions to discover, classify, analyze, protect, and monitor data. The absence of a stated classification or analysis method does not itself establish AI or make these ordinary functions unexplained AI-dependent.
evidence_spans: discover, classify, analyze, protect and monitor personal and sensitive data
conflict_response: The labeler treated the unspecified method for classification and analysis as a weak ambiguity, while the blind proposal treated the stated privacy functions as conventional. The description names concrete data-management functions but does not describe learned models or another AI-dependent mechanism, so the conventional non-AI judgment remains supported.
